title: Looking Ahead and Back: Anticipatory Generative Modeling for Road-Network Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2610.13131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Trajectory generation underpins urban applications such as traffic management and urban planning. Within road networks, vehicle movement along road segments is largely deterministic, whereas transitions at intersections are critical--multiple outgoing paths may appear equally plausible, yet they can lead to substantially different downstream routes. Existing generative methods such as diffusion models simulate location sequences and fail short of next transition selection, even producing trajectories that drift off the road network. To fill this gap, we advocate a fundamental shift: moving beyond location simulation toward behavior modeling on the road network. In this paper, we revisit trajectory generation through the lens of generative route planning, and introduce a new graph-constrained generative paradigm, Anticipatory Generative Modeling, which resolves next transition selection by incorporating the Anticipation of how the future

translated_title: 瞻前顾后：面向路网轨迹的预期性生成建模
translated_abstract: 轨迹生成是交通管理和城市规划等城市应用的基础。在道路网络中，车辆沿路段的运动在很大程度上是确定性的，而在交叉路口的转向决策则至关重要——多条出路口的路径可能看起来同样合理，但它们却可能通向截然不同的下游路线。现有的生成方法（如扩散模型）仅模拟位置序列，难以完成下一步转向选择，甚至会产生偏离道路网络的轨迹。为填补这一空白，我们主张一个根本性的转变：从位置模拟转向道路网络上的行为建模。在本文中，我们从生成式路径规划的视角重新审视轨迹生成，引入了一种新的图约束生成范式——预期性生成建模，通过结合对未来路线的预期来解决下一步转向选择问题。
tldr: 提出了一种新的图约束生成范式“预期性生成建模”，将路网轨迹生成从位置模拟转向行为建模，通过预期未来路线来解决路口转向选择问题，避免轨迹偏离路网。
en_tdlr: Proposes Anticipatory Generative Modeling, a new graph-constrained generative paradigm that shifts road-network trajectory generation from location simulation to behavior modeling, resolving intersection transition selection by anticipating future routes to prevent trajectories from drifting off the road network.
